_readme: Maps NCRB's own crime-head labels (Tables 1A.4 and 1A.5, per state) onto the head names used in ncrb_crime_heads_2022.json. Keys are the NCRB leaf label after stripping the enumerator prefix ('A) ', 'a) ') and any '(Sec...)' / '(Total)' parenthetical. Values are taxonomy head names. Built by build-state-heads.js, which verifies that every head's per-state figures sum to its published national total.
